claims.quote: Our wholesale distribution team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your wholesale distribution team is currently exploring options and has not yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To ensure we align with your needs, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting to clarify what you need from Cedar Systems.

During this meeting, we can discuss your workflow coordination and account reporting requirements, and determine the best path forward. Please let us know a convenient time to connect.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What specific goals or challenges is your wholesale distribution team currently facing?
Are there any particular departments or stakeholders who would be involved in this project?
uncertainties: The lack of a clear project owner or specific requirements makes it difficult to tailor the discovery meeting effectively.
The customer has not yet identified a specific need, which may impact the value proposition we can present.
